strategy_name: Time Series Reversal Based on End-of-Month Payment Cycle
abstract: Time Series Reversal Based on End-of-Month Payment Cycle is a mean reversion strategy from Graziani 2024. Universe: SPY; rebalances monthly. Entry: Buy the S&P 500 if the return of the last week of the month (last 5 trading days of the calendar month) is negative. Enter the position at the close of the last trading day of the month.
